body_html:
So You Want Your kid to code?
Read them literature.
Code is copy pasted,
It is taught.
Portable
Beauty, however is learned.
Shared.

So you want your kid to code?
Let them play.
Friendship bracelets
music, chess,
sports.
puzzles and patterns
Passion designing passion

So you want your kid to code?
Let them lead.
in who they are
and
in what they care
then others will follow.
